name: task-mutations
body: The task arms. `add` refuses when the task FQN exists (dropping the `remove_node` upsert in `plan_add_task_at`), so status and incident `Reviews` edges survive. `update` re-validates `--verb`/`--fqn`/`--to` against the scanned graph by reusing `validate_task_verb` (and `validate_task_kind_tier`), and preserves status + Reviews. `rm` refuses (without `--force`) when the task is `done` or has ANY incident Feedback.
